components.name: Pattern/Surface container
components.description: The Main content region of the app shell (region naming: SideNav / TopNav / Main / Panel — Panel is currently an off-canvas drawer; the region name is reserved). surface-container fill, Element pad/gap/radius tokens, and the Grid/Main region style: 12 columns, 16px gutters, offset 0 (surface padding is the margin). Width 1164 = XL Main per the Foundations → Grid math (1440 − 32 − 164 − 16 − 64); min 672 = MD with collapsed SideNav. Content in the slot aligns to whole columns; developers read column spans at handoff. Note: PageLayout code renders the SideNav at 184px vs the documented 164px token — drift flagged in Foundations → Grid.

components.name: Pattern/Table
components.description: Table region pattern: no-fill (rows sit on the page surface), outline outer border, Table/cell-gap stacking. Toolbar / Table / Pagination via table slots; row hover-pressed states are additive on-surface 8%/16% overlays. Slot positions are plain inner frames — convert each ◇ frame to a native Figma slot.

components.name: size=md
components.description: Page-region section pattern: title + description + content slot. Paddings/gap bound to Section tokens; transparent shell — the page background shows through. Fill the Content slot; toggle the description.

components.name: size=lg

components.name: size=blockquote
components.description: Blockquote — Merriweather Sans Regular (400) 20px / 160%. Style: Body/Special/Blockquotes. Code: .body-blockquote-txt (--font-weight-blockquote: 400). Composite: --type-blockquote.

components.name: size=small
components.description: H6 — Lato SemiBold 16px / 150%. Style: Title/H6. Code: h6 or .h6 (--font-size-h6: 1rem). Composite: --type-h6. Same size as body1 and a different family and weight.

components.name: size=striketrough
components.description: B1 Strikethrough — Merriweather Sans Regular 16px / 150% with line-through. Style: Body/B1/Striketrough (spelling kept as published; renaming a style breaks every instance bound to it). Code: .body1-txt plus the decoration.

components.name: size=underline
components.description: B1 Underline — Merriweather Sans Regular 16px / 150% with underline. Style: Body/B1/Underline. Code: .body1-txt plus the decoration; text-decoration is not part of any type token.

components.name: size=semibold
components.description: B1 SemiBold — Merriweather Sans Regular (400) 16px / 150%. Style: Body/B1/SemiBold. Code: .body1-txt.font-weight-semibold. The name says semibold and the face is Regular; that is the system’s 400 step (--font-weight-semibold-1), not a mislabel.

components.name: size=bold
components.description: B1 Bold — Merriweather Sans Bold (700) 16px / 150%. Style: Body/B1/Bold. Code: .body1-txt.font-weight-bold (--font-weight-bold: 700).

components.name: size=lead
components.description: Lead — Merriweather Sans Light (300) 20px / 160%. Style: Body/Special/Lead. Code: .body-lead-txt (--font-size-lead: 1.25rem). Composite: --type-lead. Same 20px as h5 and blockquote; the weight is what separates them.

components.name: size=medium
components.description: H5 — Lato SemiBold 20px / 140%. Style: Title/H5. Code: h5 or .h5 (--font-size-h5: 1.25rem). Composite: --type-h5. Note that lead and blockquote are also 20px; the three differ by weight (300 / 400 / 600), which is what keeps them separate registers.

components.name: size=small caps
components.description: B3 All Caps — Merriweather Sans Light 12px / 166.7%, uppercase. Style: Body/B3/All Caps. Named "small caps" as a variant but rendered as ALL CAPS; the variant name is the one drift on this set. Code: .body3-txt with text-transform: uppercase.

components.name: size=italic
components.description: B1 Italic — Merriweather Sans Light Italic 16px / 150%. Style: Body/B1/Italic. Code: .body1-txt with an em/i element. NOTE for the composite layer: the font shorthand RESETS font-style, so `font: var(--type-body1)` on an italic element removes the italic. Set the italic after the composite, or keep the four axis tokens here.

components.name: size=default
components.description: B1 Regular — Merriweather Sans Light (300) 16px / 150%. Style: Body/B1/Regular. Code: .body1-txt (--font-size-body1: 1rem, --font-weight-normal: 300). Composite: --type-body1.
